AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds.

2. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

3. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Making Tacking Stitches? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Making Tacking Stitches.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Making Tacking Stitches.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Making Tacking Stitches.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Making Tacking Stitches.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Wild Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Wild Animals.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Wild Animals.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Wild Animals.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Wild Animals.

6. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Burning crop residue every week

7. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fuel Conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fuel Conservation.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fuel Conservation.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fuel Conservation.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Fuel Conservation.

9. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. joule (J)
   C. watt (W)
   D. pascal (Pa)

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Growing Fruits? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Growing Fruits.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Growing Fruits.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Growing Fruits.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Growing Fruits.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of Domestic Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of Domestic Animals.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of Domestic Animals.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of Domestic Animals.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of Domestic Animals.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Making Tacking Stitches and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Water Conservation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Fuel Conservation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
